caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The pitcher is rendered in translucent shades of blue and light gray, with its body displaying vertical fluted patterns on the lower half and a smooth, curving surface on the upper half. It has a broad base that gradually narrows upward before flaring out at the mouth, which is angled to form a spout. A large, curved handle is attached to the left side of the pitcher, also depicted in blue tones. The design includes two horizontal bands around the middle and lower part of the pitcher, accentuating the divisions in its structure. The background remains unadorned, with a border framing the drawing, and the artist’s signature appears in the bottom right corner outside the pitcher’s outline.
title: Cream Pitcher
